drivers_priors: Summer cash/cutout highs typically fade into Q4 as production peaks; front-Q4 contracts (V, Z) usually converge downward, so V/Z is a 'summer premium unwind' seasonal.

Basis: cash and cutout seasonality (see AMS LM_HG201 & PK600) run hardest in July–September; the front leg carries the seasonal risk premium while the back leg is more anchored to placement-cycle expectations.
PSF (pork stocks-frozen) draws and cold-storage disposition drive the G/J and Z/G legs — winter freezer draw supports G relative to H/J deferred.
ASF (2018) generated a fat right tail on multiple pairs — document as an outlier, do NOT strip it from the historical band.
Renewable-diesel / vegoil substitution and BOZM crush pressure show up first on Z/M — this is the pair most exposed to macro-feed regime shifts.
Placement / farrowing intentions (Hogs & Pigs Sept + Dec) shift the H/J/K deferreds during Q4; expect wider band-width for G/J in Q4 relative to V/Z.
notes: Band = 25/50/75 percentile across last 5 prior calendar years.

Since 2026-11-05 band, median and pctile_10y_same_doy carry each prior year's last value over weekends and holidays (between its first and last value), in pairs, contracts and open_interest; series.years and series.current stay on trading days.
Median = 10-year median across last 10 prior calendar years.
Current-year overlay uses THIS year's actual pair.
Year overlays: every prior calendar year since 1980 (band and median unchanged).
Years before 1997 predate the lean hog contract (CME converted from live hogs in Feb 1997); Norgate carries them under the HE symbols.
ASF year (2018) is retained in the historical band as a documented outlier.
contracts: outright settles of the legs, $/cwt, same year-role convention (V, Z of year Y; G, J, M, Q of Y+1), same band/median/overlay rules (added 2026-10-28; Q leg 2026-10-30).
M/Q pair added 2026-10-30: HEM(Y+1) - HEQ(Y+1). The Q contract lists around mid-April of year Y, so the series and band start there.

Season windows (2026-10-30): each block runs from 1 January of season_year to the front leg's last trading day (season_end), which for G/J, M/Q and the Feb/Apr/Jun/Aug legs falls in the next year; series.doy counts days from 1 January and can exceed 365. The current season is the nearest unexpired front leg; a completed season stays up until the next opens.

open_interest (2026-11-05): Norgate open interest of the six legs, whole contracts, same windows and band/median/overlay rules as contracts. Zero (no OI reported: before the first trade, and the latest day until the exchange publishes it) is treated as missing; summary.last_settle_date is the last OI date. Band, median and the same-day percentile carry each prior year's OI over weekends and holidays; series.years stays on trading days.
